name: Aarav's Gulab Jamun Adventure
competency: Understanding addition as cumulative grouping and multi-addend sequential sums
overview: An interactive story-based addition activity where Aarav is fed sweets by his family on his birthday. Children track incremental additions step-by-step and calculate multi-addend totals.
learningOutcomes: Recognize addition as combining consecutive quantities
Construct and evaluate multi-addend equations (a + b + c + d = Total)
Connect concrete visual manipulatives (sweets) with abstract numerical symbols

levels.name: Aarav's Birthday
levels.description: Single-step additions with 1 sweet per family member (sums up to 5)

levels.name: Family Feast
levels.description: Variable sweet portions per person (sums up to 10)

levels.name: Mega Sweet Challenge
levels.description: Larger multi-addend quantities and missing addend challenges (sums up to 20)
